# Level starts

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/level-starts.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Where each level puts player 1 when it starts: one entry per checkpoint of a story level (the
`HuCreate` for player 1 in the function the level script calls for `GetCheckPoint()`) and one per mode of a
Rumble arena (the first flag of the list `fP1` in `level<N>_<mode>_init.lua`, which the arena teleports
player 1 to).
How the game gets there: [Characters](../research/characters.md#level-starts).

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every story level whose script creates player 1 at a literal position, and every Rumble flag
    script whose name is known. The hub (`level95`) places the Warchief at a flag and is hand-written.
    A checkpoint's own script may move the player again once it has loaded (see each entry's notes).

188 entries. Data: `research/references/level-starts.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: inferred.

- level95.lua AddWarchief and AddFlagsBoxesPaths; level95_chapter<k>.lua WarchiefTable
- the level scripts, HuCreate and AddFlag

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | `<level>-<checkpoint>` for a story level, `<level>-<mode>` for a Rumble arena. |
| `level` | str | | The level's name (a [level](levels.md) record's name). |
| `checkpoint` | int | | Checkpoint (`GetCheckPoint`, `W_GameState + 0x33a`) the start belongs to. |
| `mode` | str | | Rumble mode whose flag script holds the start (`level<N>_<mode>_init.lua`). |
| `character` | str | | The name the script gives player 1's human (`HuCreate`'s first argument). |
| `type` | int | | Player 1's [character type](characters.md); a Rumble arena's comes from the chosen gang. |
| `pos` | list | | Position `{x, y, z}` in metres, game axes (z up), before the ground snap. |
| `heading` | float | | Facing in degrees about z, as `HuCreate` or the flag gives it. |
| `via` | str | | Where the value comes from: the creating function or the flag. |
| `script` | str | | The script the start loads: the checkpoint's chapter script or the mode's flag script. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
